about: How AzerothGPS StreetView ships its pictures: a download of their own (the user, 2026-10-03), the addon AzerothGPS_StreetView_Data, a CurseForge project of its own beside the viewer's, so an update of the viewer's code doesn't download the pictures again. The build writes the pictures (SD tiles scaled from build/master), their Index.lua and toc into build/packs/AzerothGPS_StreetView_Data/; `sv.cmd install` puts it beside the viewer in the game; `sv.cmd release` zips the viewer's code, `sv.cmd release-data` the pictures (both: --publish for the GitHub release whose workflow uploads to CurseForge). Without the pictures the viewer says where to get them (Core.lua ns.NeedData). The pack's zip stays under budget_bytes (CurseForge refuses files of 2 GB or more). 'spacing_yd' is how far apart the capture renders spots (the master keeps them all); 'ship_spacing_yd' how far apart the shipped ones are (pack.ship_points; 200 yd, the user 2026-09-29). 'planned' is the shipped spots expected, for projecting the full size. HD packs are not made or shipped for now.
about_city: City spots (the capitals' own streets, meta.json 'city') ship every ~75 yd: pack.ship_points thins them after the road spots, never displacing a shipped road spot.
